issues.detail: Hebrew 'בְּמָלְכוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם' means 'when he reigned in Jerusalem' (infinitive construct with suffix, 'when he was king'), but Vietnamese renders it as 'để người không thể trị vì tại Giê-ru-sa-lem' ('so that he could not reign in Jerusalem'), adding a negation and changing the meaning from a temporal clause to a purpose clause with a prohibition.
